name: llm-debugger
description: This is a VSCode extension that allows you to debug your code using an LLM.
author: Mohsen Azimi <me@azimi.me>

llmDebugger.strategy.description: Bug-hunt brain for /use-debugger: 'jev' routes each step through the fast decision model (LLM writes only the final fix); 'llm' reasons every step with the generation model (slow baseline for comparison).

llmDebugger.jevProvider.description: Where the fast decision model (Jev) is called. 'typesafe' talks to api.typesafe.ai directly; 'vercel' routes through the AI Gateway.

llmDebugger.jevApiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the decision model. Empty falls back to `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` (direct) or `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` (gateway), from the environment or an `api.env` file.

llmDebugger.jevModel.description: Decision model id. 'jev-latest' on the direct route, 'typesafe-ai/jev' through the gateway.

llmDebugger.llmProvider.description: Where the generation model is called. 'openai' talks to api.openai.com directly; 'vercel' routes through the AI Gateway.

llmDebugger.llmApiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the generation model. Empty falls back to `OPENAI_API_KEY` (direct) or `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` (gateway), from the environment or an `api.env` file.

llmDebugger.llmModel.markdownDescription: Generation model: the opening hypothesis, breakpoint locations, expressions and the final fix. `gpt-5.4-nano` answers a routing decision in about a second and solves the whole benchmark when Jev does the routing. Reach for `gpt-5.6-sol` (with `llmReasoningEffort` above `none`) on code the fast model struggles to reason about.

llmDebugger.gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Vercel AI Gateway OpenAI-compatible API.

llmDebugger.llmReasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort for the generation model. `none` keeps the fast models fast; anything above it requires the direct OpenAI route, since a reasoning model refuses function tools on `/v1/chat/completions`.

llmDebugger.openaiBaseUrl.description: Override the OpenAI base URL (for a proxy or a compatible endpoint). Empty uses https://api.openai.com/v1.

llmDebugger.typesafeBaseUrl.description: Override the TypeSafe base URL. Empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai/v1.

languageModelTools.name: llm-debugger_start
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start a Node.js debug session for a program and stop at entry. Use FIRST when asked to find a bug by debugging: the real VSCode debugger opens (breakpoints, yellow step line, variables, toolbar all on screen). Returns the entry paused state. Then set breakpoints and step.

program.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path to the file to debug

languageModelTools.name: llm-debugger_breakpoint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set or remove a breakpoint shown as a red dot in the editor at a 1-based line. Use to mark where to pause and inspect runtime values, or to clean up.

languageModelTools.name: llm-debugger_step
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Advance the paused program one debugger step and return the new paused state (stack, variables, focused source). Kinds: next, in, out, continue. The editor highlight moves with each call.

languageModelTools.name: llm-debugger_state
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read current debugger state (paused stack, local variables, breakpoints, focused source, recent output) without moving execution. Call after each step.

languageModelTools.name: llm-debugger_evaluate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the paused frame and return its value. The cheapest way to test a hypothesis about runtime state without stepping.

expression.description: Expression valid in the paused frame

languageModelTools.name: llm-debugger_triage_jev
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ask the fast decision model (~300ms, near-free), what debugger action to take next from the paused state. Returns recommended action with confidence plus ready-for-fix probability. Prefer over slow reasoning for routine step routing.

languageModelTools.name: llm-debugger_diagnose_llm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ask the fast LLM via Vercel AI Gateway (streams back fast) to analyze the paused state and propose the next action WITH parameters or write the code fix. Use for fix synthesis and explanations, not routine step routing.

languageModelTools.name: llm-debugger_stop
languageModelTools.modelDescription: End the debug session. Returns final output plus cost ledger (steps, fast checks, LLM calls). Always call when the bug is found and explained.

chatParticipants.name: debugger
chatParticipants.description: Finds bugs by stepping the real debugger and reading live values

commands.name: use-debugger
commands.description: Hunt a bug with live stepping. Usage: @debugger /use-debugger [program]

scripts.build: npm run check:manifest && npm run build:extension && npm run build:webview
scripts.dev: rm -rf out && rm -rf src/webview/out && concurrently "npm run dev:extension" "npm run dev:webview"
